fichas.title: Track and field, arena type A
fichas.summary: An eight-lane perimeter track surrounds a large inner field. The southern segment accommodates shot put, discus/hammer throwing, high jump, and javelin; the northern segment accommodates shot put, discus/hammer throwing, javelin, and a water jump for obstacle racing. A pole-vault pit with run-ups from both sides is outside the track on the east; long- and triple-jump pits with two run-ups are outside it on the west.

fichas.title: Track and field, arena type B
fichas.summary: A six-lane perimeter track surrounds a large inner field. The southern segment accommodates shot put, discus/hammer throwing, high jump, and javelin. The northern segment accommodates pole vault, javelin, discus/hammer throwing, long jump with three run-ups, and a water jump for obstacle racing. Pole-vault, long-jump, and triple-jump pits may also be arranged outside the track.
